film.title: Boca Raton, Florida: Owlcatraz (Part I)
film.description:
In February 2013 Florida Atlantic University sold the name of its football stadium to GEO Group, a private prison company headquartered in Boca Raton, for six million dollars. The students called it Owlcatraz. Six weeks later the company pulled out, and six weeks after that the president resigned. This is part one of two. Part two, The Badge on Campus, goes fifty miles south to Miami.

Narrated by Matthew Hagan. Gary Mercer and Graig Zaunneessee are fictional AI anchors with AI voices and are not affiliated with any school. The narrator is real. The opening score is original.

Local history... and college basketball. See more at https://hardwoodbricks.com

reels.title: Owlcatraz, Part I: the name on the stadium
reels.text: In 2013 a private prison company paid six million dollars to put its name on Florida Atlantic's football stadium. The students had a name for it within a day. Part I, a minute from our new film, Boca Raton, Florida: Owlcatraz.

reels.title: Owlcatraz, Part I: it signed
reels.text: The kids won. Six weeks and a nickname sent a three billion dollar company home. Then, twelve years later and fifty miles south, another Florida university got an offer. Part I, a minute from our new film, Boca Raton, Florida: Owlcatraz.
